Title: Q: On Contested Pentex Subv. Who Pays For Contesting????

Messages.Author: Robert Goudie
Messages.Body:
Pentex Subversion (PS) is a unique master that you play on a ready minion
which then makes it so the minion cannot take any further actions and he
or she cannot block actions until the card is burned. PS may be burned
by any minion as a (D) action.

If, for example, I play a PS on my prey's Zoe and then next master phase
play an additional PS on my prey's Didi Meyers, who decides whether to
yield or pay to continue contesting?

Does the Meth. who originally played the PS have to pay and therefore get
to decide on yielding or is it the Meth. who's minions have been
affected?

Robert

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
The control of master cards doesn't change unless a card effect specifically
says so. For example, you are the controller of any Pentex Subversion you
play, even though you are playing them on other Methuselahs' minions.

Messages.Author: David Hyatt
Messages.Body:
Robert Goudie <Robert...@studio.disney.com> writes:

>Pentex Subversion (PS) is a unique master that you play on a ready minion
>which then makes it so the minion cannot take any further actions and he
>or she cannot block actions until the card is burned. PS may be burned
>by any minion as a (D) action.

>If, for example, I play a PS on my prey's Zoe and then next master phase
>play an additional PS on my prey's Didi Meyers, who decides whether to
>yield or pay to continue contesting?

>Does the Meth. who originally played the PS have to pay and therefore get
>to decide on yielding or is it the Meth. who's minions have been
>affected?

The Methuselah who played the Pentex Subversions is considered the
controller of the cards, so he would be contesting his own cards.

Messages.Author: Brian Kallenbach
Messages.Body:
David Hyatt wrote:
> The Methuselah who played the Pentex Subversions is considered the
> controller of the cards, so he would be contesting his own cards.

Which, thus, makes it an illegal play, with the ruling on contesting your own cards.
